description: Comprehensive database of RPM macros with documentation, expansions, and examples

define.name: define
define.details: Macros defined with %define will not last to another RPM section. For example, if used in preamble section, the macro will be automatically undefined in %prep. To make sure a macro lasts for the entire spec file, use %global instead.

global.name: global
global.details: As oppose to %define, macros defined with %global will last for the entire spec file.

undefine.name: undefine
undefine.details: Technically this does not always undefine the macro specified. Instead, this pops the latest definition from the macro stack.

dnl.name: dnl
dnl.details: Similar to # …, this can comment out anything in %{dnl:…} or after %dnl …. The difference with # … is that %dnl prevents macro expansions, while macros in # … are actually expanded.

load.name: load
load.details: Loads an external macro file for use in the spec file.

expr.name: expr
expr.description: Expand all macros in the body, then evaluate the body as an expression.
expr.details: Different from %[…], this first expands macros then evaluates the expression.

expand.name: expand
expand.details: Expands the content, then expands the result again.

lua.name: lua
lua.details: Since RPM expands macros when the source RPM (SRPM) is created, the lua code is executed during that stage. Documentations for the embedded Lua interpreter are available at https://rpm-software-management.github.io/rpm/manual/lua.html.

macrobody.name: macrobody
macrobody.description: Expand to the definition of the given macro.
macrobody.details: Useful for debugging and understanding macro definitions.

quote.name: quote
quote.description: Does nothing, but useful for preserving spaces in arguments.
quote.details: Can be used to pass arguments with spaces to parameterized macros.

gsub.name: gsub
gsub.description: String substitution using Lua pattern matching.
gsub.details: Equivalent to %{lua: string.gsub("%1", "%2", %3, %?4)}, where %n represents the n-th argument to %gsub. %4 is optional and defaults to infinity. %2 is treated as a Lua pattern.

len.name: len
len.description: Obtains the length of the given text.

shescape.name: shescape
shescape.description: Escape a string for safe shell usage.
shescape.details: Wrap the input with single quotes and also escape preexisting single-quotes correctly.

shrink.name: shrink
shrink.details: Trim leading and trailing ASCII-whitespace, and reduce intermediate whitespace to a single space.

basename.name: basename
basename.description: Get the basename of a path.

dirname.name: dirname
dirname.description: Get the directory name of a path.

exists.name: exists
exists.details: Expands to 1 if the file exists, 0 otherwise.

suffix.name: suffix
suffix.description: Get the suffix of a filename.

uncompress.name: uncompress
uncompress.description: Expand to a command for uncompressing a file.
uncompress.details: Used in %setup for uncompressing source files.

getncpus.name: getncpus
getncpus.description: Get number of available CPU cores.
getncpus.details: When used as %{getncpus} with no arguments, expands to the number of available CPU cores.

echo.name: echo
echo.details: The printing happens when the macro is evaluated and expanded.

warn.name: warn
warn.details: Produced RPM warning is immediately shown in console stderr, and displayed again at the end of rpmbuild execution.

error.name: error
error.description: Print error to stderr and return error.
error.details: Produces an RPM warning, immediately shown in console stderr, then immediately perform Executing(rmbuild) and exit.

verbose.name: verbose
verbose.details: %verbose: expands to 1 if rpm is in verbose mode, 0 if not. %{verbose:...}: expands to ... if rpm is in verbose mode, empty string if not.

forgemeta.name: forgemeta
forgemeta.description: Process forge metadata for source archives.

debug_package.name: debug_package
debug_package.details: Can be disabled with %define debug_package %nil to prevent RPM from generating -debuginfo/-debugsource packages.

_build_id_links.name: _build_id_links
_build_id_links.details: Settings: none, alldebug, separate, compat. Set to 'none' for problems with /usr/lib/.build-id.

_missing_build_ids_terminate_build.name: _missing_build_ids_terminate_build
_missing_build_ids_terminate_build.description: Control build termination on missing build IDs.

__requires_exclude.name: __requires_exclude
__requires_exclude.details: rpmbuild generates Requires automatically. Add regex to exclude patterns.

__brp_mangle_shebangs_exclude_from.name: __brp_mangle_shebangs_exclude_from
__brp_mangle_shebangs_exclude_from.details: RPM mangles shebangs by default. Use this to exclude files matching a regex.

__brp_mangle_shebangs.name: __brp_mangle_shebangs
__brp_mangle_shebangs.details: As a last resort, undefine this macro. Try __brp_mangle_shebangs_exclude_from first.

bcond_with.name: bcond_with
bcond_with.details: Takes 1 argument: the name of the conditional. See https://rpm-software-management.github.io/rpm/manual/conditionalbuilds.html

bcond_without.name: bcond_without
bcond_without.details: Takes 1 argument: the name of the conditional. See https://rpm-software-management.github.io/rpm/manual/conditionalbuilds.html

autosetup.name: autosetup
autosetup.details: By default uncompresses %{SOURCE0}. Wrapper around %setup and %autopatch.

arguments.name: c
arguments.description: create directory and cd into it

setup.name: setup
setup.details: Only available in spec file. In most cases use %autosetup instead.

arguments.name: c
arguments.description: create directory and cd into it

autopatch.name: autopatch
autopatch.details: Wrapper around %__apply_patch. Not a wrapper around %patch.

patch.name: patch
patch.details: Only available in spec file. Use %autopatch instead if possible.

buildroot.name: buildroot
buildroot.details: Only available in a spec file. Path where files should be installed for packaging.

find_lang.name: find_lang
find_lang.details: Expands to /usr/lib/rpm/find-lang.sh %{buildroot}. Used for i18n files.

fdupes.name: fdupes
fdupes.details: Takes a glob path. Use -s for symlinks instead of hardlinks.

configure.name: configure
configure.description: Run configure script with correct flags.
configure.details: Expands to ./configure with correct flags. May need autoreconf -fi for some packages.

make_install.name: make_install
make_install.description: Run make install with correct flags.

cmake.name: cmake
cmake.details: Expands to %__cmake with correct flags like -B "%__cmake_builddir".

meson.name: meson
meson.details: Equivalent to %__meson setup with correct flags.

_distro_extra_cflags.name: _distro_extra_cflags
_distro_extra_cflags.details: Not defined by default on Fedora. Use for -Wno-… flags.

_distro_extra_cxxflags.name: _distro_extra_cxxflags
_distro_extra_cxxflags.details: Not defined by default on Fedora.

nim_prep.name: nim_prep
nim_prep.details: Sets mold as linker and runs nimble setup -y.

nim_c.name: nim_c
nim_c.description: Compile Nim project with C backend.

rustflags_debuginfo.name: rustflags_debuginfo
rustflags_debuginfo.details: Default is 2. Lower if gdb crashes in find-debuginfo.

_libdir.name: _libdir
_libdir.details: Expands to /usr/lib64 on 64-bit systems, /usr/lib on 32-bit or noarch.

buildsubdir.name: buildsubdir
buildsubdir.details: Set by %setup -n to the directory name.

name.name: name
name.details: Defined in the Name: preamble field.

version.name: version
version.details: Defined in the Version: preamble field.

release.name: release
release.details: Defined in the Release: preamble field.

epoch.name: epoch
epoch.details: Defined in the Epoch: preamble field.

summary.name: summary
summary.details: Defined in the Summary: preamble field.

description.name: description
description.details: Specifies the description of a package. Not a section, but a directive.

package.name: package
package.details: Specifies the preambles for a subpackage.

prep.name: prep
prep.details: Required section that prepares sources by extracting them to the build directory.

build.name: build
build.details: Optional section where sources are compiled to binaries.

install.name: install
install.details: Required section where software installation layout is prepared.

check.name: check
check.details: Optional section where tests are executed.

files.name: files
files.details: Required section that specifies all files that the package contains.

macro-manipulation.name: Macro Manipulation
macro-manipulation.description: Macros for defining, modifying, and manipulating other macros

string-operations.name: String Operations
string-operations.description: Macros for manipulating strings and text

file-and-path-operations.name: File and Path Operations
file-and-path-operations.description: Macros for working with files and paths

environment-info.name: Environment Info
environment-info.description: Macros for getting environment and system information

output.name: Output
output.description: Macros for printing output during build

spec-specific.name: Spec-Specific
spec-specific.description: Macros specific to spec file handling

preamble.name: Preamble Macros
preamble.description: Macros typically used in the preamble section

c-c++.name: C and C++
c-c++.description: Macros for C and C++ build systems

paths.name: Path Macros
paths.description: Macros that expand to common filesystem paths

automatic.name: Automatic Macros
automatic.description: Automatically defined macros from preamble fields

sections.name: Section Macros
sections.description: Macros that define spec file sections

🏷️.name: Auto-defined
🏷️.description: Usually defined but not used directly
